declarations.type:

  (lease :

  (now : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.LeaseActive lease now →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.LeaseExpired lease now

declarations.type:
∀ {HolderId SnapshotId : Type}
  (lease :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.RecoveryLease HolderId SnapshotId)
  (maximumDuration now : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.LeaseDurationBound lease
      maximumDuration →
    lease.issuedAt + maximumDuration ≤ now →
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.LeaseActive lease now

declarations.type:
∀ {HolderId SnapshotId : Type}
  (lease :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.RecoveryLease HolderId SnapshotId)
  (newHolder : HolderId) (now newExpiry : Nat),
  (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.takeoverLease lease newHolder now
          newExpiry).leaseEpoch =
      lease.leaseEpoch + 1 ∧
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.takeoverLease lease newHolder now
          newExpiry).publicationRevision =
      lease.publicationRevision + 1
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.takeover_increments_epoch_and_revision

declarations.type:
∀ {HolderId SnapshotId : Type}
  (lease :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.RecoveryLease HolderId SnapshotId)
  (newHolder candidateHolder : HolderId) (now newExpiry expectedRevision : Nat) (candidateSnapshot : SnapshotId),
  ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.PublicationLeaseFence
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedPublicationRecoveryLease.takeoverLease lease newHolder now
        newExpiry)
      candidateHolder lease.leaseEpoch expectedRevision now candidateSnapshot

  (candidateHolder : HolderId) (candidateLeaseEpoch expectedRevision now : Nat) (candidateSnapshot : SnapshotId),
